title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Page Arthur B’s 2nd Largest Position
text:
Page Arthur B reduced its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.5% in the 2nd quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The firm owned 25,716 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,487 shares during the period. Apple comprises about 4.3% of Page Arthur B’s portfolio, 2nd biggest holding. Page Arthur B’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,760,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
